field.label: Enable public CLI network
field.help: Use targets exposed by the optional native public-network CLI.

field.label: Enable automatic edge network
field.help: Use the automatic edge target and configured compatible edge endpoints.

field.label: HTTP target list URL
field.help: Public JSON list used for compatible HTTP measurement targets.

field.label: Automatic edge endpoint
field.help: Origin used for edge download and upload endpoint measurements.

field.label: Auto-refresh public targets
field.help: Refresh enabled networks automatically when this page opens and the saved list is stale.

field.label: Refresh interval
field.help: Minutes between automatic public target-list refreshes.

field.label: Maximum candidates per network
field.help: Maximum configured/public candidates to latency-probe for an automatic test.

field.label: Latency samples
field.help: Number of latency probes per target. Selection uses the median plus a jitter penalty.

field.label: Probe timeout
field.help: Seconds to wait for an automatic target-selection probe.

field.label: Transfer test duration
field.help: Seconds per direction for compatible HTTP transfer measurements.

field.label: Transfer streams
field.help: Concurrent HTTP transfer streams used by compatible engines.
